Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second inning! The umpires are ready on the spot and so are the fielders of England Women. Phoebe Litchfield will be opening with Georgia Voll for Australia Women. Lauren Bell gets the job to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... SECOND INNINGS ...

In the final session, they finished the remaining job. They finally bowled out the English batters for a mere 170 runs! Alana King was the standout for the Australia Women as he finished with a four fer. Darcie Brown and Kim Garth picked up with two wickets each while Ash Gardner chipped in with one. For the England Women, Natalie Sciver-Brunt scored a half century while Sophia Dunkley, Heather Knight and Danni Wyatt-Hodge played crucial cameos. Can the England Women pick early wickets? Or will the Australia Women continue to dominate? Stay tuned as we will be back with the Australia Women reply in a short while...

Another dominant display of bowling from the Aussies! They had dominated the opening two sessions of this Test, reducing England Women to 142/7 at dinner break. Kim Garth struck early, dismissing Maia Bouchier and Heather Knight, before Alana King claimed 3 wickets to leave England facing an uphill battle to reach 200. Nat Sciver-Brunt's unbeaten 51 provided the lone resistance for the visitors.

OUT! RUN OUT! Not the way England Women was hoping to end the inning but they did all they could! Short of a length, on off. Ryana Macdonald-Gay knocks it towards the left of the short cover fielder. Both the batters agreed to take a single but had to pay the price. Darcie Brown quickly charges the ball as they say the batters are taking a single and has a shy towards striker's end and Beth Mooney did the rest of the job. England Women scored 170 on the board to finish off their first inning!
